description:
Spotify to Teams Status Sync

Automatically syncs your currently playing Spotify track to your Microsoft Teams status message. Set a custom status message using placeholders like {artist}, {track}, {album}, and {emoji}.

- fix(sync): handle-gated drain + async commands and InvalidGrant hardening by @Carme99 in #234
- fix(security): bind per-launch secret into OAuth state, redact logs, drop store/shell by @Carme99 in #235
- fix(svelte): batch hygiene + lift reconnect handlers to layout by @Carme99 in #237
